text: 2026-09-22 review, scope clarifications grounded in current code: (1) Source adapter: a generic timed-annotation table adapter (declared onset/offset or point columns, description, optional group/location/character columns, per-part axes) producing the TimedSegment contract, migrated out of embed-bench, with Sherlock (SherlockAnnotations + ClockRepair) as one named preset. (2) Video + annotations: accept an optional verified caption/feature sidecar bound to the source edition. The annotation-only profile never silently consumes it, and the AV profile refuses without it. (3) Text sources: either a supplied StoryModel (storyBuild output) or a named deterministic offline segmentation profile (e.g. sentence/paragraph targets on the text axis). State which, and never require a hosted parse for story+recall mapping. (4) Recall readers replace bench RecallWordsCsv (comma split, no quoting, Double seconds) with a quoting-correct, exact-rational adapter consistent with the timing ticket bd-01M2WVH1DC8ZPDC992G4MX3TXG.
